text: ちからわざを　あまり　このまず　ちょうのうりょくを　じざいに　あやつって　あいてを　たおす。

structure.jp: ちからわざを　あまり　このまず
structure.en: it doesn't much like feats of strength, and

structure.jp: ちょうのうりょくを　じざいに　あやつって
structure.en: wielding its psychic powers at will

patterns.name: 〜ず
patterns.explanation: ず is a written-style 'not' that also lets the sentence carry on, like 'doesn't ..., and'. このまず = 'does not like, and'.

patterns.name: あまり〜ない
patterns.explanation: あまり together with a 'not' verb means 'not very much'. あまり このまず = 'does not like it much'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins this action to the next one, here showing the way the next thing is done. あやつって たおす = 'defeats them by wielding it'.
